# scm_dlp_document_type (Resource)

> **Beta / Experimental:** Enterprise DLP support (`scm_dlp_*`) in `terraform-provider-scm` is currently in **Beta / Experimental** and subject to schema or behavior changes.

[Beta / Experimental] Manages an Enterprise DLP Document Type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A document type used for document fingerprinting.
resource "scm_dlp_document_type" "contracts" {
  name                = "Customer-Contracts"
  description         = "Fingerprint of the standard customer contract template"
  category            = "Legal"
  detection_technique = "document_fingerprint"
  original_file_name  = "customer-contract.pdf"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `category` (String) Category of the document type (e.g. Confidential, Financial, etc.).
- `detection_technique` (String) Detection technique: document_fingerprint or trainable_classifier.
- `name` (String) The name of the document type.
- `original_file_name` (String) Original sample file name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the document type.
- `l1_category_id` (Number) Level 1 Category ID.
- `l2_category_id` (Number) Level 2 Category ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the document type.
- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing DLP document type by its ID.
terraform import scm_dlp_document_type.example <id>
```
